impact_assessment.benefits: One SQL order, no schema change; makes new arrivals visible for both the owner and each person's copies.
impact_assessment.risks: Alias drift between photos.received_at and copies.added_at; sort menu clutter; README limit.
impact_assessment.mitigation: single order helper with owner-aware timestamp, unit/HTTP/static tests, README sentence, gate and UI review.
